# Nile Dental Studio — a working demo by Desert Launch

> A working demo of a dental clinic website with its front-desk dashboard, by Desert Launch: treatments and prices, online booking with real slot rules, appointments and patient records. Fictional clinic, sample data.

A fictional business: the names, prices, address and phone numbers are invented, and the data is sample data that resets on refresh.

This is one of six live demos published by Desert Launch (https://www.desertlaunch.dev/), a software development company in Cairo, Egypt that builds mobile apps, web platforms, MVPs and internal business systems for clients in Egypt, the Gulf, Europe and the US. The demos exist so a prospective client can try the customer-facing flow and then see it arrive on the staff side. The full list, how to use them and what a real build adds: https://www.desertlaunch.dev/demos/ (Arabic: https://www.desertlaunch.dev/ar/demos/).

## What this demo is

- Kind of business portrayed: dental clinic, set in Dubai.
- Interface language: English.
- Everything runs in the browser against an in-memory store. There is no backend, no database, no accounts and no payments; nothing entered is sent anywhere, and a refresh resets the data.
- The demo is intentionally excluded from search engines (noindex) because it is not a real business.

## What works

- Treatments and prices
- Online booking with real slot rules (lunch break, closed day, nothing inside two hours)
- Reschedule, change status or cancel
- Front-desk diary and appointment list
- Patient records with notes
- Optimistic updates with a deliberate ~10% cancellation failure to show rollback

## Where to look

- / — home with the next available slot
- /services — treatments and prices
- /book — the booking flow
- /admin — clinic dashboard
- /admin/appointments — search, filter, reschedule, cancel
- /admin/patients — records

Any of these would be adapted to a real business's services, prices, hours, languages and brand, on a real database with accounts, payments and hosting where needed. Desert Launch quotes a fixed price in writing after a free scope call. WhatsApp: +20 102 283 8534. Email: abdullah@desertlaunch.dev.
